formula_hypotheses.project_blueprint_original: Final Yield = (Base Yield + Library Flat Bonus) * (1 + Rune Multipliers) * Batch Multiplier
formula_hypotheses.status: HYPOTHESIS, revised. The original blueprint put the rune AFTER the Library bonus; the iron ore data points the other way
formula_hypotheses.rune_order_supported: rune acts on the base, Library added after (option B). Evidence: iron ore Regular Lvl 1-5 before and after a Mines rune: base 90,108,130,156,187 (after removing +45); predicted 144,164,188,217,251; displayed 145,164,189,217,251. Applying 10% to the whole figure (option A) overshoots by 3 to 4 at every level Strengthened 2026-10-26 17:40: tested over iron ore Lvl 1-15; applying 10% to the whole displayed figure matches 0 of 15 levels
formula_hypotheses.jo_belief: option A (rune after Library) was Jo's belief; the data does not support it
formula_hypotheses.rounding: HYPOTHESIS (leading candidate): round up after applying the rune to the base. Iron Regular Lvl 1-15: ceil 14 of 15 exact, round-to-nearest 8 of 15, rune-on-whole-figure 0 of 15 (see production_formulas.json)
formula_hypotheses.batch_multiplier: untested for rune-eligible buildings (they have no batch slider as far as seen)
formula_hypotheses.see: production_formulas.json for the tables and the seed multipliers
